import numpy as np
def equation(t, A, params):
    p = params
    return (p[0] + p[1]*A + p[2]*A**2 + p[3]*A**3
            + np.exp(-p[4]*t)*(p[5] + p[6]*A + p[7]*A**2)
            + p[8]*t*A**3 + p[9]*t**3)
